text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, I... won—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is amazing...!
Her speed is insane!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
A real genius girl has arrived, huh?!
Congratulations, Flower-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer-sa...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So... please... don't look... so worried...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "I want you to smile. Could you... smile for me...?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Just now... was—
choice_data_list: Let's rest in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (...Ehehe.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, so that person is their Trainer.
Impressive that they managed to scout this girl.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
someone praised you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Winning is so nice, it makes me so happy.
It was really tough, but... Trainer smiled so happily at me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Thanks to Trainer, my body doesn't hurt nearly as much as it did during my debut race...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (...I was wondering why it had to be "now", but...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe it's precisely because...
it was "now"...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...All right.
I've decided...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
about our next target race...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to come back here again.
When the cherry blossoms are in full bloom...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to challenge the Triple Tiara route...
I want to run in the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara route consists of the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
They are GⅠ races that can only be run during the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, she proved she has what it takes at the GⅠ level, demonstrating a run that promises great things for the Classic division.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Let's go, to the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, please take care of me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to challenge the gateway
to the Triple Tiara: the Oka Sho!
However, there was one thing lingering on my mind—
choice_data_list: Was that your plan from the very beginning?
Did you have that planned from the start?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who choose the Hanshin JF often proceed to the Triple Tiara path afterwards.
It is only natural to seek races of a higher caliber.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, even the Hanshin JF
was a bold choice for her. Perhaps she just
kept her dreams to herself, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, that's...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll tell you all about it
once the Oka Sho is over!"
